encryptionKeyMissing.message: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set, so backups are written unencrypted and secrets cannot be stored. A future release will refuse to start without it.

jwtSecretWeak.title: JWT_SECRET is weak
jwtSecretWeak.message: JWT_SECRET is a published placeholder or too predictable, so session tokens can be forged. Generate a strong one (openssl rand -base64 32). Changing it stops authenticator codes from working and forgets trusted devices: users sign in with a backup code and set up 2FA again, and you reset 2FA in User Management for anyone without one. See docs/backend/modules-and-runtime.md (Changing JWT_SECRET) first.
